hints.title: Preorder Chain Reorganization
hints.text: Rearrange the tree so each node right child points to its preorder successor and all left children are null.

hints.title: Morris Predecessor Splicing
hints.text: For each node with a left child, locate the rightmost node in the left subtree and attach the current right subtree there.

hints.title: In-Place Pointer Rewiring
hints.text: While current node is not null, if it has a left child, find the rightmost node of that left child. Set that rightmost node right pointer to current right, then move current left child to right, and set left to null. Advance current to its right child.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Optimal Morris-style in-place flattening in O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Collecting nodes in an array and re-linking takes O(N) auxiliary memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Splicing predecessors in-place avoids extra memory allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Flatten in-place with O(1) auxiliary space without breaking existing subtree connections.
